addedCurrent.author: Greeks.live
addedCurrent.title: Low volatility keeps downside hedges attractive to the publisher
addedCurrent.view: Greeks.live describes a consolidating market with dispersed gamma exposure and subdued implied volatility. It sees insufficient evidence for a major bull cycle and continues to favour monthly out-of-the-money put protection. The post was published October 22 ahead of the October 23 expiry.

addedCurrent.author: Block Scholes
addedCurrent.title: A Fed meeting inside the window has not lifted volatility broadly
addedCurrent.view: Block Scholes notes muted crypto volatility despite the October 28 Fed meeting falling inside its 30-day window. It reports BTC implied volatility at 40.1%, ETH at 54.9% and SOL at 61.2%; BTC rose 1.4 points over seven days while ETH and SOL declined.

addedHistorical.author: QCP Capital
addedHistorical.title: Low implied volatility may conceal expiry sensitivity
addedHistorical.view: QCP observes below-average implied volatility across BTC tenors and suggests dealer long gamma may be containing price swings. It warns that this stabilizing effect could diminish as options expire; a range break could reprice spot and implied volatility, without expiry alone determining direction.
